svg.aria-label: How Coinbase earns — and where the dollars actually pool
svg.text: How Coinbase earns — and where the dollars actually pool
Two demand pools (trading fees + interest on USDC/cash) fan into Coinbase's product lines, then pool back onto the partners that
catch the economics: Circle (USDC issuer), the banks holding reserves, and the L1 networks Coinbase stakes into.
money embedded in a finished chip
Source: COIN FY2025 10-K (Note 4 Revenue; Circle Agreement; staking disclosure) + Q4'25 shareholder letter, 2026-02-12
